name: Xoi xiu
summary: Sticky rice with xá xíu, lạp xưởng, and a savory sauce with pepper. VnExpress calls the rice chewy and fragrant, the sausage rich, and the xá xíu soft and sweet.
origin: Nam Định street snack. The Nam Định city portal on 17 October 2018 names it, and Dân Việt on 5 September 2025 and VnExpress on 18 March 2016 describe the bowl.
texture: VnExpress calls the rice chewy and fragrant, the sausage rich, and the xá xíu soft and sweet, with pepper in the sauce. Eat it while it is still steaming.
howToEat: As a street portion. Mix the bowl and eat it while it is still steaming.
where: Phố Bắc Ninh on Dân Việt. Hoàng Văn Thụ and Hàng Sắt on VnExpress. Both stay.
seoTitle: Xoi xiu — sticky rice and char siu in Nam Dinh
seoDescription: Sticky rice with xá xíu, sausage, and a peppery sauce on phố Bắc Ninh, Hoàng Văn Thụ, or Hàng Sắt.
